text: Simone de Beauvoir's The Second Sex was banned in Francoist Spain in 1955 in its Spanish-language translation, which was printed in Argentina. In 1956 the Vatican placed it on the Index librorum prohibitorum, its index of prohibited books, where it remained until the policy of prohibition was abolished in 1966.
